The coachman gets down; the horses snort; the trace-horses look round; the centre horse in the shafts switches his tail, and turns his head up towards the wooden yoke above it... the great gate opens creaking; the coachman seats himself.... the village is before us.

arxiv-2001-05502.title: Entanglement generation via power-of-SWAP operations between dynamic electron-spin qubits
arxiv-2001-05502.creator: =Hugo V. Lepage, =Aleksander A. Lasek, David R. M. Arvidsson-Shukur, Crispin H. W. Barnes
arxiv-2001-05502.description: Abstract Surface acoustic waves (SAWs) can create moving quantum dots in piezoelectric materials. Here we show how electron-spin qubits located on dynamic quantum dots can be entangled. Previous theoretical and numerical models of quantum-dot entanglement generation have been insufficient to study quantum dynamics in realistic experimental devices.

arxiv-2002-11562.title: Declarative Programming with Intensional Sets in Java Using JSetL Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2002-11562.creator: Maximiliano Cristiá*, Gianfranco Rossi, Andrea Fois
arxiv-2002-11562.description: Abstract Intensional sets are sets given by a property rather than by enumerating their elements. In previous work, we have proposed a decision procedure for a first-order logic language which provides Restricted Intensional Sets (RIS), i.e., a sub-class of intensional sets that are guaranteed to denote finite—though unbounded—sets.

arxiv-2310-04812.title: Applications of Littlestone dimension to query learning and to compression
arxiv-2310-04812.creator: Hunter Chase, James Frietag, Lev Reyzin
arxiv-2310-04812.description: Abstract In this paper we give several applications of Littlestone dimension. The first is to the model of Angluin and Dohrn 2017 , where we extend their results for learning by equivalence queries with random counterexamples. Second, we extend that model to infinite concept classes with an additional source of randomness.

arxiv-2409-15590.title: MapEx : Indoor Structure Exploration with Probabilistic Information Gain from Global Map Predictions
arxiv-2409-15590.creator: Cherie Ho, Seungchan Kim, Brady Moon, Aditya Parandekar, Narek Harutyunyan, Chen Wang, Katia Sycara, Graeme Best, Sebastian Scherer
arxiv-2409-15590.description: Abstract Exploration is a critical challenge in robotics, centered on understanding unknown environments. In this work, we focus on robots exploring structured indoor environments which are often predictable and composed of repeating patterns. Most existing approaches, such as conventional frontier approaches, have difficulty leveraging the predictability and explore with simple heuristics such as ‘closest first’.

arxiv-2509-13852.title: Trace Sampling 2.0: Code Knowledge Enhanced Span-level Sampling for Distributed Tracing Conference: ; Apr 14 – 21, 2026; Rio De Janeiro, Brazil
arxiv-2509-13852.creator: Yulun Wu, Guangba Yu, Zhihan Jiang, Yichen Li, Michael R. Lyu
arxiv-2509-13852.description: Abstract . Distributed tracing is an essential diagnostic tool in microservice systems, but the sheer volume of traces places a significant burden on backend storage. A common approach to mitigating this issue is trace sampling, which selectively retains traces based on specific criteria, often preserving only anomalous ones.

arxiv-2510-08061.title: Optimization of Quadratic Constraints by Decoded Quantum Interferometry
arxiv-2510-08061.creator: Daniel Cohen Hillel
arxiv-2510-08061.description: Abstract A recent paper by Jordan et al. introduced Decoded Quantum Interferometry (DQI), a novel quantum algorithm that uses the quantum Fourier transform to reduce linear optimization problems – max-XORSAT and max-LINSAT – to decoding problems. In this paper, we extend DQI to optimization problems involving quadratic constraints, which we call max-QUADSAT.

arxiv-2510-09233.title: β \beta -Ga 2 O 3 (001) surface reconstructions from first principles and experiment
arxiv-2510-09233.creator: Konstantin Lion, Piero Mazzolini, Kingsley Egbo, Toni Markurt, Oliver Bierwagen, Martin Albrecht, Claudia Draxl
arxiv-2510-09233.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive investigation of reconstructions on β \beta -Ga 2 O 3 (001) combining first-principles calculations with experimental observations. Using ab initio atomistic thermodynamics and replica-exchange grand-canonical molecular dynamics simulations, we explore the configurational space of possible reconstructions under varying chemical potentials of oxygen and gallium.

pmc-10649888.title: Risk of kidney failure in patients with systemic sclerosis: a nationwide population-based study
pmc-10649888.creator: Oh Chan Kwon, Kyungdo Han, Min-Chan Park
pmc-10649888.description: ObjectiveData from a decade ago have shown that patients with systemic sclerosis (SSc) have a higher risk of kidney failure than the general population. However, as the incidence of kidney failure due to SSc has been declining, the comparative risk of kidney failure between patients with SSc and the general population could have changed over time.

pmc-11327301.title: Analyzing world city network by graph convolutional networks
pmc-11327301.creator: Linfang Tian, Weixiong Rao, Kai Zhao, Huy T. Vo
pmc-11327301.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). British scholar Peter Taylor constructed the World City Network by analyzing the office networks of multinational companies, enabling a network perspective on world cities. However, this method has long been hindered by data deficiencies and update delays. In this study, we utilized publicly available, real-time updated data on global routes to construct the World City Network, thereby addressing the issues of data insufficiency and delayed updates in the existing model.

pmc-11411846.title: Validation of the Revised Screening Scale for Pedophilic Interests (SSPI-2) in Portugal
pmc-11411846.creator: Cláudia Gouveia, Marta Sousa, Olga Cunha, Michael Seto, Andreia de Castro-Rodrigues, Rui Abrunhosa Gonçalves
pmc-11411846.description: The accurate assessment of pedophilic sexual interests is crucial for the treatment and management of individuals who have sexually offended children. This study aimed to validate the Revised Screening Scale for Pedophilic Interests (SSPI-2) in a Portuguese sample of 170 men convicted of sexual offenses against children, 104 serving sentences in the community, and 66 in prison.

pmc-11548519.title: Rapeseed—An Important Oleaginous Plant in the Oil Industry and the Resulting Meal a Valuable Source of Bioactive Compounds
pmc-11548519.creator: Ancuţa Petraru, Sonia Amariei, Nicoleta-Gabriela Hădărugă
pmc-11548519.description: Rapeseeds (Brassica napus), cultivated widely as a source of oil, generate substantial by-products after oil extraction. Unfortunately, rapeseed meal is considered a waste product and as such is discharged into environment as compost or used as animal feed. However, this meal is rich in bioactive compounds (proteins, minerals, fibers and polyphenols), indicating its potential for the development of value-added products.

pmc-11603340.title: Default mode network and dorsal attentional network connectivity changes as neural markers of spinal manipulative therapy in lumbar disc herniation
pmc-11603340.creator: Xing-chen Zhou, Shuang Wu, Kai-zheng Wang, Long-hao Chen, Shuang-wei Hong, Yu Tian, Hui-jie Hu, Jia Lin, Zi-cheng Wei, Yun-xing Xie, Zi-hui Yin, Zhi-zhen Lv, Li-jiang Lv
pmc-11603340.description: Spinal manipulative therapy (SMT) has been shown to significantly alleviate pain in patients with lumbar disc herniation (LDH), with its effects closely associated with brain function modulation. This study investigates the neural biomarkers linked to pain relief efficacy following a complete SMT treatment cycle in LDH patients.

pmc-11715533.title: Capacity for Alzheimer’s Disease confirmatory testing in the US ‐ current situation and simulations for future increase
pmc-11715533.creator: Sophie Roth, Jessie T Yan, Maria‐Magdalena Patru, Soeren Mattke, Gustaf Ortsäter, Anders Gustavsson
pmc-11715533.description: BackgroundRecent advances in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) disease modifying therapies (DMTs) emphasize the need of an early, timely and accurate diagnosis to initiate treatment and improve patient outcomes. Clinicians must confirm amyloid pathology through cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) testing or amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) scan to qualify patients.

pmc-12425312.title: Prevalence and risk factors for severe food insecurity and poor food consumption during a drought emergency in Ethiopia
pmc-12425312.creator: Noah Baker, Yunhee Kang, Gregory Makabila, Seifu Tadesse, Shannon Doocy, Abraham Flaxman, Abraham Flaxman
pmc-12425312.description: Frequent drought has heightened nutritional concerns in Ethiopia. This study retrospectively assesses the prevalence and risk factors of severe food insecurity and poor food consumption in Productive Safety Net Programme households in drought-prone Ethiopia. Data was from the USAID-funded Resilience Food Security Activity baseline survey in East Hararghe, Ethiopia.

pmc-12564327.title: Development of Nanobody-Based Sandwich ELISA Resistant to SpA Interference for Sensitive Detection of Staphylococcal Enterotoxin A
pmc-12564327.creator: Chenghao Hu, Di Wang, Yangwei Ou, Ruoyu Li, Qi Chen, Peng Liu
pmc-12564327.description: Staphylococcus aureus is a major pathogen responsible for staphylococcal food poisoning (SFP), with its pathogenicity primarily dependent on staphylococcal enterotoxins (SEs). Among these, staphylococcal enterotoxin A (SEA) is a critical risk factor due to its high toxicity, high detection rate (accounting for 80% of SFP cases), strong thermal stability, and resistance to hydrolysis.

pmc-12948358.title: Utilisation du matériel génétique extrait des tests de diagnostic rapide du paludisme en PCR lors du Grand Magal de Touba au Sénégal
pmc-12948358.creator: Coumba DIOUF, Ihssane OUADDANE, Georges DIATTA, Mamadou Lamine Bara GOUMBALA, Abdourahmane SOW, Déguène FAM, Mbayang FAYE, Philippe GAUTRET, Cheikh SOKHNA
pmc-12948358.description: RÉSUMÉIntroductionLe Grand Magal de Touba (GMT) est un événement religieux qui attire entre quatre et cinq millions de pèlerins et présente un risque important de transmission de maladies infectieuses dont le paludisme. L’utilisation des tests de diagnostic rapide (TDR) est habituelle lors de cet événement.

pmc-12963951.title: Institutional Review Board Obligations Regarding Study Funding Sufficiency
pmc-12963951.creator: Holly Fernandez Lynch, Tasneem Mohammad
pmc-12963951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Given their obligations to ensure ethical research, we argue that institutional review boards (IRBs) bear a responsibility to minimize the possibility that proposed clinical studies will terminate early for insufficient funding. Underfunded studies raise several ethical concerns, including potentially failing to satisfy the social value requirement for research, the possibility of leaving study participants worse off, and exposing participants to the “completion misconception,” thereby impairing adequate informed consent.

pmc-13146043.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1673 VERTEBRAL ARTERY DISSECTION PRESENTING AS POSITION-TRIGGERED EPISODIC VERTIGO IN A YOUNG WOMAN: A CASE REPORT
pmc-13146043.creator: Dibij Adhikari, Sobin Pant, Raju Pandit, Jayaram Lamichhane, Bikram Gajurel
pmc-13146043.description: Background and aimsVertebral artery dissection (VAD) is a major cause of posterior circulation stroke in young adults, but may initially present with isolated vertigo mimicking benign vestibular disorders, risking misdiagnosis and treatment delay.MethodsWe describe a previously healthy 38-year-old woman with acute episodic, position-triggered vertigo, detailing clinical examination, neuroimaging, vascular work-up, management and short-term follow-up.

pmc-13186854.title: Neuroimmunomodulation of AMPA Receptors Through Combination of Medium-Chain Triglycerides and Perampanel to Treat Status Epilepticus in Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis
pmc-13186854.creator: Laura Marie Stadler, Laurin Schappe, Piergiorgio Lochner, Luna Bonifer, Mathias Fousse, Sven G. Meuth, Sergiu Groppa, Yaroslav Winter
pmc-13186854.description: Recent studies have shown that a ketogenic diet containing medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs) has a synergistic effect with perampanel in modulating AMPA receptors. Both MCTs and perampanel have immunomodulatory properties. However, the use of the combination of MCTs and perampanel to treat status epilepticus caused by autoimmune encephalitis has never been investigated.

pmc-13443986.title: Bridging gaps in diabetic neuropathy care: A Delphi‐based regional consensus from the Gulf Cooperation Council
pmc-13443986.creator: Abdulrahman Alshaikh, Abdulnabi T Alattar, Ahmed Abdul Karim Hassoun, Afaf Alshammary, Hussein Elbadawi, Khaled Aldossari, Noor Al Busaidi, Saud Alsifri, Talal Muzaffar, Wiam I Hussein, Christine Talaat, Abanoub Effat, Marwa Elsaghier, Rayaz A Malik
pmc-13443986.description: Aims/IntroductionDiabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) is a common complication of diabetes in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, associated with delayed diagnosis, significant pain burden, and preventable complications. This Delphi‐based consensus aimed to identify regional gaps in screening and management to develop practical, evidence‐based recommendations tailored to GCC healthcare systems.

pmc-13461168.title: PGC-1α pathway dysregulation disrupts myofiber specification in a mouse model of SBMA
pmc-13461168.creator: Curtis J. Kuo, Laura B. Chopp, Zhigang Yu, Luhan Ni, Hien T. Zhao, Janghoo Lim, Andrew P. Lieberman
pmc-13461168.description: Skeletal muscle pathology is a critical but poorly understood contributor to neuromuscular degeneration in spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy (SBMA), a CAG/polyglutamine (polyQ) expansion disorder caused by mutation in the androgen receptor (AR). Using a gene-targeted SBMA mouse model, we applied single-nucleus RNA sequencing to identify a disease-specific population of skeletal muscle myonuclei that replaced normal myonuclear subtypes.

pmc-13549558.title: Association between alpha-1-acid glycoprotein and serum uric acid in young and middle-aged US women
pmc-13549558.creator: Jiangtao Zhu, Mengge Feng, Wenqi Wu, Jianhua Zhang, Guoliang Xu, Yujie Ma
pmc-13549558.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Evidence on the association between alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP), a systemic inflammatory marker, and serum uric acid (SUA) remains limited, particularly among young and middle-aged women. Using cross-sectional data from 614 US women aged 20 to 49 years from the 2015 to 2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, we assessed the AGP-SUA relationship and the mediating role of the triglyceride-glucose index using multiple linear regression, smooth curve fitting, and mediation analysis.

pmc-13629531.title: Memorization Modulates the Lifespan of Event Files
pmc-13629531.creator: Anna Scotts, Malte Möller, Ruyi Qiu, Iring Koch, Susanne Mayr

pmc-13672526.title: A multidisciplinary approach for the study of age-dependent expression patterns in porcine experimental wounds
pmc-13672526.creator: Cecilie Bækgård, Lars Andresen, Marie Høy Hansen, Henrik Elvang Jensen, Kristine Freude, Kristiane Barington
pmc-13672526.description: Determining the age of wounds in both human and veterinary subjects is a critical aspect of forensic pathology. Gross and histopathological evaluations are used for age estimations, however, these evaluations are subjective as they rely on the opinion and experience of the examining pathologist.
